subject: Ping: API rate limit errors in prod logs
body_html:
Hey,

Seeing a spike in 429 errors from the payment gateway API in production logs since 14:00 UTC. About 3% of payment requests are failing. I think we might be hitting the 1000 req/min ceiling. Can you investigate?

Sam
